layout.photograph: Centered cover crop on desktop and portrait

motion.name: simulation-step
motion.purpose: Continuous meteor travel and train decay; speed multiplier 0.3–2.

motion.name: render-limit
motion.value: 30 FPS default; host range 1–60, reduced-motion maximum 15
motion.purpose: Honor host performance settings with bounded backing pixels.

motion.name: atmospheric-train
motion.purpose: Quadratically fading residue with subtle lateral drift.

rendering.technique: Canvas 2D photograph plus procedural screen-blended meteor cores, glow and scintillation
rendering.pauseAndVisibility: Cancel timer and animation frame while paused or hidden; restart when allowed
rendering.reducedMotion: Still frame after 12 simulated seconds; explicit host resume permits animation
rendering.preview: Seeded still frame through ?preview=<seconds>, clamped to 0–120
rendering.fallback: Bundled photograph during loading, with recovery paragraph if photograph loading fails

components.name: Meteor sky
components.description: Original Milky Way over dark alpine scenery with narrow meteor cores, occasional fireballs and atmospheric trains.

components.name: Photograph fallback
components.description: Centered cover photograph with a bottom recovery message on image-load failure.

narrative.overview: An original photographic night sky provides a quiet backdrop for a realistic artistic meteor shower. Fine bright cores, restrained bloom and subtle stars preserve the night-photography atmosphere.
dos: Preserve narrow cores and restrained bloom.
Keep all controls in the host.
Honor bounded actors, pixel budgets and renderer lifecycle.
donts: Do not add a HUD or embedded controls.
Do not bake shooting stars into the photograph.
Do not present the scene as an astronomical observation or forecast.
